g.text: Power packets are separate from waveform samples

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26364b

g.text: TSP1 stores squared magnitudes without phase. Full Y is 384,512 x 4 = 1,538,048 bytes and remains a

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26364b

g.text: separate output. The TCP service selects sparse; the adapter also supports dense.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a66882
font-size: 13.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26364b

g.text: Each entry is bin8 + power56. DC is retained, so 1 <= K <= 129. At K=129, sparse

text.style: font-size: 13.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26364b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d78a8
font-size: 13.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26364b

g.text: 48-byte header + 129 x 7-byte powers + one pad byte. Sparse does not always

text.style: font-size: 13.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #26364b

g.text: save bytes. Byte counts do not describe WAV compression.
